prompts.snack: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent animation sprite sheet for a small personal desktop pet. Use the reference image as the strict character identity and drawing-style reference: Cinnamoroll, white puppy, very long floppy ears, warm thin tan outline, oval sky-blue eyes, tiny tan mouth, pale pink cheeks, small curled tail, tiny round paws, soft hand-drawn watercolor shading. Match this exact character, not a generic rabbit. Exactly two arms and two legs, no extra hands or detached paws. Production layout: exactly 8 animation frames in a precise uniform 4-column by 2-row grid, read top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Canvas 1536 by 768 pixels if possible; every cell 384 by 384. No text, grid lines, numbers, borders, labels or watermarks. Genuine fully transparent background. Full character, props and ears fit inside each cell with padding, identical camera, scale, horizontal center and ground baseline in all eight cells. Deliberately restrained smooth animation; frame 8 loops back to frame 1. Action: a complete cinnamon-roll nibbling loop. Standing front three-quarter view, both original little hands hold one cinnamon roll at chest height. Frames 1-2 lift the roll gently toward his mouth; 3-4 take one tiny nibble with closed smiling eyes; 5-6 soft cheek chewing with the roll still held securely; 7-8 settle back to the starting pose. The character's two hands belong to the two arms throughout; never add a second pair. No plates, floating food, crumbs or bouncing props.
